summary.text: Andrew Stoddard is a Democratic state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 40 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an attorney who lives in the Salt Lake Valley.

paragraphs.text: Andrew Stoddard graduated from Brighton High School, earned a B.A. in psychology from the University of Utah in 2007, and received a J.D. from Brigham Young University in 2011, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as an attorney at the Utah Crime Victims Legal Clinic, as a city prosecutor for Murray City, and as an attorney at Craig Swapp & Associates.
He served as chair of the Midvale Community Council.

In the 2023-2024 legislative term, Stoddard was assigned to the House Ethics Committee, the Government Operations Committee, the Law Enforcement and Criminal Justice Committee and the House Rules Committee.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026.
